tasks.label: Quarto Preview Site (Debug Ready)
tasks.command: $port=4200; $running=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if(-not $running){Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-Command','quarto preview --port 4200 --no-browser' -WindowStyle Minimized; Write-Host "Aguardando Quarto..."; do{Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $ok=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}while(-not $ok); Write-Host "Quarto pronto na porta $port!"}else{Write-Host "Quarto já rodando na porta $port"}

tasks.label: Preview Apresentação (Quarto)
tasks.command: Set-Location '${fileDirname}'; $port=8765; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $html='${fileBasenameNoExtension}.html'; Start-Process "http://localhost:${port}/$html"; python -m http.server $port
